坐姿，法國號抱在身前，號口朝右後方。右手放入號口（用於控制音準和音色），左手按活: Sit with the horn held in front of the body, the bell facing to the right and back. The right hand goes into the bell (used to control intonation and timbre) and the left hand works the valves. The lips vibrate to make the sound. The horn has a wide range and needs precise lip control. Practising the harmonic series is the key.

法國號主要由黃銅製成，包括彎曲的管身、活塞機制與喇叭口。號嘴通常採用銀或銅製，提: The French horn is mainly made of brass, including the curved tubing, the valve mechanism and the bell. The mouthpiece is usually silver or copper, giving good transmission of vibration. The inner slides are brass or nickel silver, and the outer slides are brass or silver-plated to improve durability and tone quality. The inside of the bell is often silver-plated to improve the timbre. The valve mechanism is made of precise metal gears and springs that keep the pitch accurate.
法國號以雙唇振動號嘴發聲，音高受氣流速度、嘴唇張力與左手轉閥影響，右手置入朝後喇: The French horn sounds by the two lips vibrating at the mouthpiece; the pitch depends on the speed of the air, the tension of the lips and the rotary valves worked by the left hand, while the right hand in the rear-facing bell adjusts fine pitch and timbre. A double horn has a range reaching from C2 to C6, more than four octaves. Its tone is softer than other brass, unlike the sharpness of the trumpet; the B♭ branch is brighter and more forceful and the F branch warmer, so it blends into a woodwind ensemble, and it is the only brass instrument in the wind quintet. The source does not say clearly how its volume is controlled.
法國號常見於職業管弦樂團與管樂隊，也出現在歌劇、交響樂段、銅管五重奏與木管五重奏: The French horn is common in professional orchestras and wind bands and also appears in opera, symphonic passages, brass quintets and wind quintets, the last being the one ensemble in which brass joins woodwind. The early hunting horn was used for hunting, and today the natural horn recreates period performance. Worth listening to are Prokofiev's Peter and the Wolf, where three horns represent the wolf, and Mozart's four horn concertos, Weber's Concerto in E minor, Richard Strauss's First and Second Horn Concertos in E flat and Glière's Horn Concerto in B flat.
法國號源於獸角與早期狩獵號角。17世紀末名稱開始使用，法國製作者擅長獵號並形成圓: The French horn comes from animal horns and the early hunting horn. The name came into use at the end of the seventeenth century, and French makers excelled at hunting horns and developed the circular shape. The early natural horn had no valves and sounded by the lips and the harmonic series; in the middle of the eighteenth century the right hand was put into the bell to tune it, and German makers used crooks to change the key. In 1818 Stölzel and Blümel took out a patent on the rotary valve, and around 1839 Périnet introduced the piston valve in France. In the middle of the nineteenth century the German three-valve single horn became the mainstream; in 1897 Kruspe brought out the F/B♭ double horn; in Britain the piston type was still preferred into the 1930s, and after the mid-1940s the German type gradually prevailed.
法國號（French horn）為氣鳴銅管樂器，H-S編號423.232。其吹管: The French horn is a brass aerophone, H-S number 423.232. Its tube is long and narrow, wound into a circular body, ending in a funnel-shaped bell and fitted with rotary valves. The player sounds it by vibrating the lips against the air in the mouthpiece; the left hand works the valves to change the length of the tubing and the right hand goes into the bell to adjust the pitch. Professional orchestras and wind bands today mostly use the F/B♭ double horn, played by horn players.
